prompts.column: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single isolated architectural illustration for a premium food brand's surreal engraved paper universe. Subject: one tall ancient fluted stone column, weathered and slightly chipped, simple classical capital and wide layered stone plinth, small fragments at its foot, elegantly tapering shaft. The entire freestanding column must be visible from top to base, no cropping, portrait composition with generous transparent padding all around. Perspective slight three-quarter view, mostly frontal. Medium: exceptionally fine 19th century copperplate etching, pencil-thin navy-charcoal ink hatching and stippling, hand engraved mineral cracks, sophisticated archival botanical atlas aesthetic. Crisp irregular line detail, restrained shading, airy open areas, no heavy solid blacks. This will flank large centered typography as an independent parallax layer, so do not include any scene around the column. Genuine transparent alpha background, no paper rectangle, no text, no border, no ground plane, no sky, no additional columns. Pure illustration, not a photo or 3D render.
prompts.cloud: Use case: illustration-story. Create one isolated long low cloud formation as a transparent-background illustration asset for an elegant surreal engraved paper universe. A natural wind-swept cloud bank with two irregular overlapping billowing formations, subtly stretched horizontally, wisps dissolving at the sides, asymmetrical airy silhouette. Medium: fine 19th century copperplate engraving in desaturated navy-charcoal ink, tiny delicate parallel curved hatch strokes following the billows, sparse stipple, luminous open areas, lighter detail than a stone engraving. Premium archival atlas illustration, highly refined organic drawing, no cartoon scallops, no harsh solid black areas. Landscape composition, entire cloud visible, generous transparent space around it. Genuine transparent alpha background; empty areas between fine ink strokes should be transparent wherever possible. No sky rectangle, no paper background, no ground, no rocks, no text, no sun, no frame. This asset will float independently above centered type on warm kraft paper.
